Lalita stay
Aug 2025
We stayed ad the Lalita for just one night but we loved the place. Everyone was so nice and welcoming. We arrived at 7am and they got our room ready in 1 hour so we could change and take a shower. At night we tried the cocktails that they served us in the pool, amazing! It was good after a day of bicycling (that the hotel provided for free)!
Dinner at the restaurant was also very good and we had the opportunity to learn some Vietnamese words thanks to the staff!
I can only but recommend it

Good drinks and meals in ninh binh
Aug 2025 • Friends
Perfect spot to have a drink and a good dinner in Ninh Binh! The rooftop restaurant and bar at Lalita Hotel in Ninh Binh is a real gem. The food is delicious, with every dish prepared fresh and full of flavor. The staff are incredibly friendly and always happy to recommend dishes or even teach you a few words of Vietnamese, which makes the experience even more special. Highly recommended for both the food and the warm, welcoming atmosphere!
